fateflip.draw.title: Draw your fate
fateflip.draw.subtitle: Flip a card. Then... stop, or flip again?
fateflip.draw.subtitle.again: That card burned. Fate owes you another.
fateflip.draw.last: Last card: it will apply no matter what.
fateflip.controls.sealed: Your controls have been scrambled. The Controls screen is sealed.
fateflip.controls.locked.title: Controls sealed
fateflip.controls.locked: "%s" keeps the controls sealed for %s more seconds.
fateflip.glyphs.hello: The world now speaks to you in glyphs.
fateflip.narrator.name: The Narrator
fateflip.grimoire.title: Grimoire of Fate
fateflip.grimoire.hint: Hover a card to read it.
fateflip.grimoire.footer: Tab: next family · K or Esc: close
fateflip.grimoire.unknown.desc: Flip it during a draw to discover it.
fateflip.cmd.stop: The card's effect has been lifted.
fateflip.shards.name: fate shards
fateflip.power.title: Powers
fateflip.power.clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
fateflip.power.clairvoyance.desc: Card backs reveal their family and intensity.
fateflip.power.reprieve.name: Reprieve
fateflip.power.reprieve.desc: One more flip for this draw.
fateflip.power.phoenix.name: Phoenix
fateflip.power.phoenix.desc: A burned card rises from its ashes: you can take it back.
fateflip.power.phoenix.pick: Phoenix: click a burned card to revive it (Esc to cancel)
fateflip.power.half_measure.name: Half Measure
fateflip.power.half_measure.desc: The card you keep will only last half as long.
fateflip.achievement.5: Plant a seed in your mind
card.fateflip.triptych.name: Triptych
card.fateflip.triptych.desc: Your screen is cut into three strips that reshuffle every time you change hotbar slot.
card.fateflip.mirror.name: Mirror
card.fateflip.mirror.desc: The whole world steps through the looking glass.
card.fateflip.antipodes.name: Down Under
card.fateflip.antipodes.desc: Upside down. The sky is on the floor.
card.fateflip.taquin.name: Sliding Puzzle
card.fateflip.taquin.desc: Your view becomes a 3×3 sliding puzzle that shuffles itself.
card.fateflip.kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
card.fateflip.vertigo.name: Vertigo
card.fateflip.vertigo.desc: Your screen slowly spins around. Don't look down.
card.fateflip.portrait.name: Vertical Video
card.fateflip.portrait.desc: Shot on a phone. Vertically, of course.
card.fateflip.wandering.name: Wandering Window
card.fateflip.wandering.desc: The game shrinks and drifts through the void.
card.fateflip.melt.name: Meltdown
card.fateflip.melt.desc: The picture drips like hot wax.
card.fateflip.whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
card.fateflip.whirlpool.desc: Everything gets sucked towards the middle of your screen.
card.fateflip.fisheye.name: Fisheye
card.fateflip.fisheye.desc: A bulging wide angle, like a security camera.
card.fateflip.shattered.name: Shattered
card.fateflip.shattered.desc: Your screen is cracked into misaligned shards.
card.fateflip.noir.name: Film Noir
card.fateflip.noir.desc: Black and white, grain and vignette. It's always raining in this town.
card.fateflip.scarlet.name: Scarlet
card.fateflip.scarlet.desc: The world loses its colours... except red.
card.fateflip.negative.name: Negative
card.fateflip.negative.desc: Colours flip, like an old film negative.
card.fateflip.thermal.name: Thermal Vision
card.fateflip.eight_bit.name: 8-Bit
card.fateflip.eight_bit.desc: Chunky pixels and a retro palette.
card.fateflip.pocket.name: Pocket Console
card.fateflip.pocket.desc: Four shades of green on a dot-matrix screen.
card.fateflip.vhs.name: Worn VHS
card.fateflip.vhs.desc: Tracking lines and bleeding colours. Be kind, rewind.
card.fateflip.crt.name: Old TV
card.fateflip.crt.desc: Curved glass, scanlines and a cathode glow.
card.fateflip.anaglyph.name: 3D Glasses
card.fateflip.anaglyph.desc: Red on one side, cyan on the other. Where are the glasses?
card.fateflip.tipsy.name: Tipsy
card.fateflip.tunnel.name: Tunnel Vision
card.fateflip.tunnel.desc: Darkness closes in, to the beat of your heart.
card.fateflip.sketch.name: Sketchbook
card.fateflip.sketch.desc: The world, redrawn in pencil on paper.
card.fateflip.source_code.name: Source Code
card.fateflip.source_code.desc: You finally see the world for what it is: characters.
card.fateflip.psychedelic.name: Psychedelic
card.fateflip.myopia.name: Short-Sighted
card.fateflip.echolocation.name: Echolocation
card.fateflip.echolocation.desc: Pitch black. Only the pulses reveal the world.
card.fateflip.wet_lens.name: Wet Lens
card.fateflip.comic.name: Comic Book
card.fateflip.comic.desc: Flat colours, inked outlines and halftone dots.
card.fateflip.cinemascope.name: Cinemascope
card.fateflip.cinemascope.desc: Black bars, a wide frame and blockbuster colour grading.
card.fateflip.night_goggles.name: Night-Vision Goggles
card.fateflip.night_goggles.desc: Green phosphor, grain, and the world through two eyepieces.
card.fateflip.colour_swap.name: Colour Swap
card.fateflip.colour_swap.desc: Red, green and blue trade places.
card.fateflip.selfie.name: Selfie
card.fateflip.selfie.desc: The camera turns to face you. Say cheese!
card.fateflip.barrel_roll.name: Barrel Roll
card.fateflip.barrel_roll.desc: The camera banks into turns... and sometimes does a barrel roll.
card.fateflip.spyglass.name: Spyglass
card.fateflip.spyglass.desc: A permanent 4× zoom. Good luck aiming.
card.fateflip.ultrawide.name: Ultra-Wide
card.fateflip.ultrawide.desc: A 150° field of view. Everything looks miles away.
card.fateflip.breathing.name: Breathing World
card.fateflip.breathing.desc: The world breathes in... and out.
card.fateflip.hiccups.name: Hiccups
card.fateflip.hiccups.desc: Hic! Your view jolts without warning.
card.fateflip.seasick.name: Seasick
card.fateflip.seasick.desc: The world rocks like a boat on a swell.
card.fateflip.dinnerbone.name: Dinnerbone
card.fateflip.dinnerbone.desc: Every creature walks around upside down.
card.fateflip.paper_world.name: Paper World
card.fateflip.paper_world.desc: Creatures become as flat as paper cut-outs.
card.fateflip.wonky_scale.name: Wonky Scale
card.fateflip.wonky_scale.desc: Every creature looks absurdly sized. It's only an illusion.
card.fateflip.screensaver.name: Screensaver
card.fateflip.screensaver.desc: Your HUD bounces from corner to corner.
card.fateflip.amnesia.name: Amnesia
card.fateflip.amnesia.desc: You can't remember what's in your hotbar.
card.fateflip.ghost_crosshairs.name: Ghost Crosshairs
card.fateflip.ghost_crosshairs.desc: Five crosshairs. Only one is real.
card.fateflip.narrator.name: The Narrator
card.fateflip.narrator.desc: A voice comments on everything you do. With a certain contempt.
card.fateflip.glyphs.name: Enchanter's Glyphs
card.fateflip.glyphs.desc: Chat and tooltips are written in the Galactic alphabet.
card.fateflip.eyelids.name: Heavy Eyelids
card.fateflip.eyelids.desc: You blink. Slowly. Far too slowly.
card.fateflip.eclipse.name: Eclipse
card.fateflip.eclipse.desc: For you alone, it's the dead of night.
card.fateflip.deluge.name: Deluge
card.fateflip.deluge.desc: A thunderstorm breaks out... and only you can see it.
card.fateflip.pea_soup.name: Pea Soup
card.fateflip.pea_soup.desc: A thick, coloured fog swallows the landscape.
card.fateflip.party.name: Party Time
card.fateflip.party.desc: Confetti and fireworks with every move you make.
card.fateflip.scrambled_keys.name: Scrambled Keys
card.fateflip.scrambled_keys.desc: Forward, back, left, right, jump and sneak are shuffled. The Controls screen is sealed.
card.fateflip.inverted_mouse.name: Inverted Mouse
card.fateflip.inverted_mouse.desc: Up is down, left is right.
card.fateflip.steadicam.name: Steadicam
card.fateflip.steadicam.desc: Cinema camera: every movement is smooth... and late.
card.fateflip.coffee.name: Triple Espresso
card.fateflip.coffee.desc: Your mouse can't settle: too fast, then too slow.
card.fateflip.hotbar_chaos.name: Capricious Hotbar
card.fateflip.hotbar_chaos.desc: Keys 1 to 9 and the scroll wheel do as they please.
card.fateflip.crab_walk.name: Crab Walk
card.fateflip.crab_walk.desc: Moving forward makes you sidestep, and vice versa.
card.fateflip.helium.name: Helium
card.fateflip.helium.desc: Every sound turns squeaky, like a helium voice.
card.fateflip.deep_voice.name: Deep Voice
card.fateflip.deep_voice.desc: Every sound turns deep and slow.
card.fateflip.orchestra.name: Orchestra
card.fateflip.orchestra.desc: Every noise becomes a musical note.
card.fateflip.zoo.name: Zoo
card.fateflip.zoo.desc: Every sound is replaced by an animal noise.
card.fateflip.paranoia.name: Paranoia
card.fateflip.paranoia.desc: Footsteps behind you. A hiss. It's nothing... right?
card.fateflip.echo.name: Echo
card.fateflip.dead_silence.name: Dead Silence
card.fateflip.dead_silence.desc: Not a sound. Just your heartbeat.
card.fateflip.bad_dubbing.name: Bad Dubbing
card.fateflip.bad_dubbing.desc: Sounds arrive a second too late.
card.fateflip.video_wall.name: Video Wall
card.fateflip.video_wall.desc: Your view multiplied across nine screens. One of them has bad reception.
card.fateflip.droste.name: Droste Effect
card.fateflip.droste.desc: The screen contains the screen, which contains the screen... in a spiral.
card.fateflip.ripple.name: Ripple
card.fateflip.ripple.desc: Every three seconds, a ripple crosses your view like a pebble in a pond.
card.fateflip.glitch.name: Glitch
card.fateflip.glitch.desc: Chunks of the picture jump, slip and invert.
card.fateflip.silhouette.name: Shadow Play
card.fateflip.silhouette.desc: The world becomes black silhouettes against a sunset sky.
card.fateflip.stained_glass.name: Stained Glass
card.fateflip.stained_glass.desc: The world, seen through a cathedral window.
card.fateflip.pointillism.name: Pointillism
card.fateflip.pointillism.desc: Painted dot by dot, in the style of Seurat.
card.fateflip.xray.name: X-Ray
card.fateflip.xray.desc: Everything turns translucent and blue, like an X-ray.
card.fateflip.hologram.name: Hologram
card.fateflip.hologram.desc: The world is now a flickering holographic projection.
card.fateflip.tilt_shift.name: Miniature
card.fateflip.tilt_shift.desc: Blurred edges and vivid colours: the world looks like a tiny scale model.
card.fateflip.look_back.name: Look Behind
card.fateflip.look_back.desc: The camera looks behind you. You still walk forward.
card.fateflip.upside_down_hud.name: Upside-Down HUD
card.fateflip.upside_down_hud.desc: Your HUD has done a full half-turn.
card.fateflip.fake_achievements.name: Absurd Achievements
card.fateflip.fake_achievements.desc: The game congratulates you on some... questionable feats.
card.fateflip.zero_gravity.name: Zero Gravity
card.fateflip.zero_gravity.desc: Creatures float and tumble as if in space. In appearance only.
card.fateflip.disco.name: Disco Night
card.fateflip.disco.desc: Creatures dance, the fog changes colour and notes fly around.
card.fateflip.ice_rink.name: Ice Rink
card.fateflip.ice_rink.desc: Your movement slides as if on ice.
card.fateflip.input_lag.name: Input Lag
card.fateflip.input_lag.desc: Your mouse responds a third of a second late.
card.fateflip.leapfrog.name: Leapfrog
card.fateflip.leapfrog.desc: Jump makes you sneak, sneak makes you jump.
card.fateflip.crossed_ears.name: Crossed Ears
card.fateflip.crossed_ears.desc: What comes from the left sounds like it's on the right, and vice versa.
card.fateflip.warped_vinyl.name: Warped Vinyl
card.fateflip.warped_vinyl.desc: The pitch of every sound wobbles like a warped record.
card.fateflip.elevator_music.name: Elevator Music
card.fateflip.elevator_music.desc: A little tune plays on loop. Everything else goes quiet.
fateflip.narrator.intro.0: Good evening. I shall be your narrator. Sadly.
fateflip.narrator.intro.1: Let us resume. Our hero, as heroic as ever.
fateflip.narrator.intro.2: The Narrator is back. You didn't ask for this.
fateflip.narrator.intro.3: Quiet on set. Well, you're the one going in circles.
fateflip.narrator.jump.0: Our hero jumps. The audience holds its breath. No, it doesn't.
fateflip.narrator.jump.2: Another jump. Gravity, at least, never gets bored.
fateflip.narrator.jump.3: Jumping as if about to fly away. Spoiler: no.
fateflip.narrator.sprint.0: He runs! Towards what? Nobody knows. Least of all him.
fateflip.narrator.sprint.1: A frantic dash towards... the next spot over.
fateflip.narrator.sprint.2: Sprinting now. Hunger will catch up soon enough.
fateflip.narrator.sneak.0: Sneaking. As subtle as a pig in a library.
fateflip.narrator.sneak.2: Nobody can see you. Except me. And everyone.
fateflip.narrator.sneak.3: Ah, stealth. An art you are only just discovering.
fateflip.narrator.water.0: Splash. Our hero discovers water. Wet, apparently.
fateflip.narrator.water.2: Water. The one place where your shoes are no longer the problem.
fateflip.narrator.water.3: An impromptu bath. Nobody will judge you. Except me.
fateflip.narrator.inventory.0: He opens his bag. For the twelfth time. Nothing has changed.
fateflip.narrator.inventory.1: Inventory. The great tidy-up won't happen today.
fateflip.narrator.inventory.2: What is he looking for? He doesn't know either.
fateflip.narrator.inventory.3: Ah, the inventory. A museum of mess.
fateflip.narrator.eat.0: He eats. Fine dining can pack up and go home.
fateflip.narrator.eat.1: A quick bite, standing up, in the middle of nowhere. Living the dream.
fateflip.narrator.eat.2: Devouring. With the grace of a starving wolf.
fateflip.narrator.hurt.0: Ouch. That wasn't in the script.
fateflip.narrator.hurt.1: Our hero takes a hit. The audience claps politely.
fateflip.narrator.hurt.3: Another wound. Your doctor won't be pleased.
fateflip.narrator.fall.1: A dramatic fall. Note the style.
fateflip.narrator.fall.3: Going down. By the quickest route.
fateflip.narrator.idle.3: A well-earned break. Mostly for me.
fateflip.narrator.attack.0: He strikes! The air had better watch out.
fateflip.narrator.attack.1: A mighty blow. Well, a blow.
fateflip.narrator.attack.3: He swings. The blocks tremble. A little.
fateflip.narrator.use.0: He uses something. What? A mystery. Why? A greater mystery.
